turn.description: Run one full agent turn — tool-enabled via the desktop sidecar (approval-gated), text-only fallback on web.
turn.label: Agent turn

request.description: Pause until a human approves or rejects — from the desktop notification center or a paired phone. Routes downstream via Approved / Rejected handles.
request.label: Request approval

send.description: Sends a message as a chosen character into a session.
send.label: Send as character

update.description: Patches fields on an existing character.
update.label: Update character

delete.description: Recalls / deletes an already-sent platform message via a connected adapter.
delete.label: Delete message

draft.description: Stores the proposed reply for human review in the Inbox.
draft.label: Save as draft

forward.description: Forwards a message (or merge-forwards several) to another conversation via a connected adapter.
forward.label: Forward message

reaction.description: Adds an emoji reaction to a platform message via a connected adapter.
reaction.label: React to message

send.description: Pushes a message through the outbound queue of a connected adapter.
send.label: Send via connector

waitReply.description: Pauses the run until a matching inbound message arrives in the conversation (or the wait times out). Routes the reply text downstream.
waitReply.label: Wait for reply

click.description: Click an element or absolute screen coordinate.
click.label: Click

findElement.description: Locate a UI element by name / automation id / control type.
findElement.label: Find element

invokePattern.description: Dispatch a UIA pattern (Invoke / Toggle / Value / Transform / …).
invokePattern.label: Invoke pattern

keys.description: Send a keyboard chord like ctrl+shift+t.
keys.label: Send keys

launchApp.description: Launch an application by path/name, or focus an existing window by process.
launchApp.label: Launch app

paste.description: Paste text via the clipboard (saves + restores the user clipboard).
paste.label: Paste text

readTree.description: Snapshot the accessibility subtree as JSON for downstream nodes.
readTree.label: Read tree

screenshot.description: Capture the primary monitor or a region. Returns PNG bytes + dims.
screenshot.label: Screenshot

type.description: Type a string into the focused element via SendInput.
type.label: Type text

wait.description: Block until an element appears, disappears, or matches a property.
wait.label: Wait for element

windowClose.description: Close a window via the UIA Window pattern.
windowClose.label: Close window

windowFocus.description: Bring a window to the foreground.
windowFocus.label: Focus window

windowResize.description: Move/resize a window via the UIA Transform pattern.
windowResize.label: Resize window

branch.description: Create or switch to a branch.
branch.label: Git branch

commit.description: Commit staged changes with a message (optionally signed off).
commit.label: Git commit

push.description: Push commits to a remote (optionally set upstream).
push.label: Git push

stage.description: Stage paths in the repo (git add). Defaults to the active workspace root.
stage.label: Git stage

analytics.description: Compute goal completion, status, token, and timeline analytics.
analytics.label: Goal analytics

clearSubgoals.description: Remove the persisted subgoal checklist from a goal.
clearSubgoals.label: Clear subgoals

create.description: Create a self-driving /goal for a chat session through the GoalRuntime.
create.label: Create goal

decomposeSubgoals.description: Use the configured judge model to decompose a goal into a checklist.
decomposeSubgoals.label: Decompose subgoals

delete.description: Delete a goal and its event log through GoalRuntime cleanup.
delete.label: Delete goal

events.description: Read a goal's lifecycle event timeline.
events.label: List goal events

get.description: Read one goal by id and return a redaction-safe snapshot.
get.label: Get goal

list.description: List goals globally, by session, or the active/open goal for a session.
list.label: List goals

pause.description: Pause an active goal and abort its in-flight turn driver.
pause.label: Pause goal

preempt.description: Mark an active goal as superseded by external work.
preempt.label: Preempt goal

resume.description: Resume a paused goal so its turn loop can continue.
resume.label: Resume goal

stop.description: Stop a non-terminal goal and fire terminal goal side effects.
stop.label: Stop goal

createGoal.description: Resolve a goal template and create a GoalRuntime-backed goal for a session.
createGoal.label: Create goal from template

delete.description: Delete a user-authored goal template; built-in templates remain protected.
delete.label: Delete goal template

favorite.description: Set a goal template's favorite flag so it sorts near the top of pickers.
favorite.label: Favorite goal template

list.description: List seeded and user-authored goal templates with favorite/search filters.
list.label: List goal templates

upsert.description: Create or update a user goal template while preserving built-in clone semantics.
upsert.label: Upsert goal template

toggleSubgoal.description: Flip one subgoal checklist item's done state.
toggleSubgoal.label: Toggle subgoal

updateConfig.description: Patch pacing, budget, judge, and timeout settings on a non-terminal goal.
updateConfig.label: Update goal config

updateObjective.description: Replace a non-terminal goal objective via the GoalRuntime redaction path.
updateObjective.label: Update goal objective

invokeTool.description: Calls a tool on a configured MCP server.
invokeTool.label: Invoke MCP tool

recall.description: Hybrid-search the long-term memory store (BM25 + vectors when configured).
recall.label: Recall memory

store.description: Store one durable fact into long-term memory via the shared consolidator (PII-gated).
store.label: Store memory

camera.description: Opens the camera on a paired phone and returns the capture (base64) to the run.
camera.label: Take photo on phone

location.description: Reads the current GPS position from a paired phone.
location.label: Get phone location

notify.description: Shows a local notification on a paired phone.
notify.label: Notify phone

scanBarcode.description: Opens the barcode/QR scanner on a paired phone and returns the raw value.
scanBarcode.label: Scan barcode on phone

share.description: Opens the native share sheet on a paired phone with the given text or link.
share.label: Share from phone

interact.description: Feed / play with / clean the desktop pet (optionally consuming a shop item by id).
interact.label: Nurture pet

approve.description: Move a draft or pending plan into the approved state.
approve.label: Approve plan

cancel.description: Cancel a non-terminal plan and emit the runtime exit event.
cancel.label: Cancel plan

create.description: Create an AgentPlan for a session through the PlanRuntime lifecycle.
create.label: Create plan

delete.description: Delete a plan and its event log through PlanRuntime cleanup.
delete.label: Delete plan

events.description: Read the newest lifecycle and step events for a plan.
events.label: List plan events

get.description: Read one persisted AgentPlan by id.
get.label: Get plan

list.description: List plans by workspace or session, with optional status filtering.
list.label: List plans

pause.description: Pause an executing plan and abort the active run controller.
pause.label: Pause plan

refine.description: Use the planner model to repair, expand, simplify, reorder, or optimize a plan.
refine.label: Refine plan

reject.description: Cancel a pending plan and record rejection feedback.
reject.label: Reject plan

resume.description: Resume a paused plan into the executing state.
resume.label: Resume plan

run.description: Execute an approved plan through the orchestrated PlanRuntime path.
run.label: Run plan

setStepStatus.description: Update one plan step's status and recompute plan progress counts.
setStepStatus.label: Set plan step status

updateDraft.description: Patch a non-executing plan's title, steps, config, or metadata.
updateDraft.label: Update plan draft

invoke.description: Calls a plugin task handler registered in the plugin runtime.
invoke.label: Invoke plugin

trigger.description: Fan out an event into event-triggered scheduler tasks.
trigger.label: Trigger scheduler event

get.description: Read one scheduler execution record by id.
get.label: Get scheduler execution

recent.description: Read recent scheduler execution rows across all scheduled tasks.
recent.label: List recent scheduler executions

statistics.description: Read aggregate scheduler task and execution counters.
statistics.label: Get scheduler statistics

status.description: Read native scheduler daemon health and lifecycle status.
status.label: Get scheduler status

backfill.description: Replay one scheduled task across an explicit time window.
backfill.label: Backfill scheduled task

create.description: Create a native scheduler task through the TaskScheduler lifecycle.
create.label: Create scheduled task

delete.description: Delete a scheduler task and its execution records.
delete.label: Delete scheduled task

executions.description: Read recent execution history for a scheduler task.
executions.label: List task executions

export.description: Export selected scheduler task definitions for migration or backup.
export.label: Export scheduled tasks

get.description: Read one native scheduled task by id.
get.label: Get scheduled task

import.description: Import scheduler task definitions from an exported JSON bundle.
import.label: Import scheduled tasks

list.description: List native scheduler tasks with optional status, type, tag, and search filters.
list.label: List scheduled tasks

pause.description: Pause a native scheduler task and disarm its next run.
pause.label: Pause scheduled task

resume.description: Resume a paused scheduler task and recalculate its next run.
resume.label: Resume scheduled task

runNow.description: Execute a scheduler task immediately through its registered task executor.
runNow.label: Run scheduled task now

update.description: Patch a scheduled task's metadata, trigger, payload, config, or lifecycle status.
update.label: Update scheduled task

upcoming.description: Read the next armed scheduler task fires across the task registry.
upcoming.label: List upcoming scheduled tasks

invoke.description: Renders a skill into the prompt of the next AI step.
invoke.label: Invoke skill

upsert.description: Creates or updates a skill with the given markdown body.
upsert.label: Upsert skill

terminal.description: Run a shell command in the integrated terminal dock. Routes stdout / exit code downstream.
terminal.label: Run terminal command

compose.description: Auto-orchestrates an agent team from a single objective: routing assessment, roster composition, and task decomposition (PII-gated). Optionally starts the team immediately.
compose.label: Compose team from objective

create.description: Creates a new agent team row.
create.label: Create team

delegate.description: Delegates a sub-problem on behalf of a team to a digital twin, a background agent, an external agent, or another team — optionally awaiting the result.
delegate.label: Delegate from team

message.description: Posts a message into an agent team's shared chat/blackboard, optionally addressed to a specific teammate or attached to a task.
message.label: Post team message

reconcile.description: Under workspace isolation, reconcile the per-dispatch agent branches produced so far in this run — merge-all / select / pipeline.
reconcile.label: Reconcile agent worktrees

run.description: Starts an agent team's lifecycle and waits for completion.
run.label: Run team

status.description: Reads an agent team's live state mid-workflow: status, final result, and optionally its tasks, teammates, and delegations.
status.label: Get team status

dispatch.description: Internal node emitted by the agent-team synthesizer. One node per team task. Not hand-authored.
dispatch.label: Dispatch team task

update.description: Patches an existing team's roster or orchestration mode.
update.label: Update team

readRecent.description: Read the recent-commands ring (command, exit code, ended-at) of a terminal dock tab.
readRecent.label: Read terminal history

script.description: Run a script file (.sh / .ps1 / .py / .js / …) under the right interpreter, detected from its extension or overridden explicitly.
script.label: Run script file

close.description: Close a terminal session opened earlier in this run. Leftover sessions are closed automatically when the run ends.
close.label: Close terminal session

open.description: Open a persistent terminal session (visible dock tab, or a headless private shell with unattended mode) for multi-step command runs.
open.label: Open terminal session

run.description: Run one command in a session opened earlier in this run and wait for its exit code.
run.label: Run in terminal session

waitForExit.description: Block until the command currently running in a terminal dock tab finishes, then route on its exit code.
waitForExit.label: Wait for terminal exit

ingest.description: Queues a new source for the twin's ingest pipeline.
ingest.label: Twin ingest

rag.description: Runs RAG over a twin's vector store and returns the top-K chunks.
rag.label: Twin RAG

browserModel.description: Run an explicitly selected Transformers.js model locally in the browser.
browserModel.label: Browser model

classify.description: LLM-based classification into one of N labels.
classify.label: Classify

council.description: Fan the prompt out to several models, then synthesize a consensus answer.
council.label: Council

embed.description: Generate an embedding vector for semantic similarity.
embed.label: Embed text

ensemble.description: Run a target N times, then vote / threshold / best-of / synthesize the samples.
ensemble.label: Ensemble

extract.description: Structured extraction (JSON schema) from free-form text.
extract.label: Extract data

prompt.description: Direct LLM call. Uses the configured provider routing.
prompt.label: AI prompt

group.description: Visual group around several nodes. Has no execution.
group.label: Group frame

note.description: Free-text note placed on the canvas. Has no execution.
note.label: Sticky note

aggregate.description: Reduce a list: collect / concat / merge / group-by / dedupe / numeric / custom.
aggregate.label: Aggregate

code.description: Custom JS expression with a 5s timeout.
code.label: Code

template.description: Render a mustache-style template string against the upstream data.
template.label: Template

transform.description: Map / filter / reduce / sort over an input array or object.
transform.label: Transform

gate.description: Pass/fail verdict for an eval run against thresholds; branches on pass / fail.
gate.label: Eval gate

run.description: Run an eval dataset against a chat / team / workflow target and output pass rates.
run.label: Run eval

branch.description: Routes execution down one of two branches based on a condition.
branch.label: If / else

break.description: Stops the innermost loop after the current iteration.
break.label: Break

catch.description: Runs only when the workflow fails terminally; receives the error and drives a recovery / notify path.
catch.label: Catch failure

continue.description: Skips the rest of the current loop iteration.
continue.label: Continue

join.description: Joins parallel branches with all/any/race semantics.
join.label: Join

loop.description: Repeats a sub-graph for-each / while / N times.
loop.label: Loop

set.description: Assigns a value to a workflow-scoped variable.
set.label: Set variable

split.description: Fans out to multiple branches that run concurrently. Pure passthrough — every branch receives the SAME input; it does not partition or copy-slice data (use flow.loop or data.aggregate group-by for that).
split.label: Split (parallel)

subworkflow.description: Invokes another workflow as a step.
subworkflow.label: Run subworkflow

switch.description: Multi-way branch on the value of an expression.
switch.label: Switch

wait.description: Pauses for a fixed duration or until a wake-up event arrives.
wait.label: Wait

http.description: Call an external HTTP API with retries and timeout.
http.label: HTTP request

output.description: Declare the workflow's typed terminal output (the published interface).
output.label: Output

webClone.description: Snapshot a live web page (HTML + all CSS/JS/image/font assets) into a self-contained file or bundle, with optional component extraction + framework codegen.
webClone.label: Web clone

respond.description: Respond to the inbound webhook trigger with a payload.
respond.label: Webhook respond

extract.description: Run OCR on an image or PDF (URL, base64, or screen) and output its text.
extract.label: Extract text (OCR)

message.description: Fires when a user sends a message in a bound character session.
message.label: On chat message

inbound.description: Fires when a message arrives on a connected platform (Telegram, Slack, ...).
inbound.label: Incoming message

cron.description: Fires on a cron schedule. Backed by the Tauri scheduler when running.
cron.label: On schedule

event.description: Fire when a UIA focus / structure / property event matches.
event.label: On UIA event

event.description: Fires when an installed Marketplace integration publishes a normalized event.
event.label: On integration event

completed.description: Fires when a /goal reaches a terminal status (completed, stopped, budget/turn/timeout).
completed.label: On goal completed

manual.description: Fires when you click Run in the editor.
manual.label: Run manually

event.description: Fires when the desktop pet levels up, evolves, unlocks an achievement, or becomes unwell.
event.label: On pet event

team.description: Internal trigger fired by the agent-team synthesizer when a team run starts. Not hand-authored.
team.label: On team run start

command.description: Fires when a command finishes in a user-spawned terminal dock tab. Scope by session, project, exit status, or a command substring.
command.label: On terminal command

webhook.description: Fires when an HTTP request hits the workflow's webhook path.
webhook.label: On webhook

completed.description: Fires when another workflow's run finishes (succeeded or failed), receiving its output as the trigger payload.
completed.label: On workflow completed
